name: Franchise Architect: Football
currentFocus: Session 90 stopped the league minting talent, closing the milestone S89 declared and deferred. A club "development bonus" was added to every player's offseason progression on top of the declared development curve; it is documented as a differentiator but measured every centre against literals the league had left behind — coaching.development against 72 when the league mean is 78.22, scheme fit against 70 when the real mean is 78.1. Scheme fit is derived from player ratings, so inflation grew the bonus and the bonus grew inflation. Measured on four seeds it was worth +0.84 OVR per player per offseason, 62% of the league positive and 3.8% negative. The declared curve's own league-mean move is -0.885, so the reported +0.228 drift was two large errors of opposite sign nearly cancelling rather than a modest calibration miss. New src/domain/developmentEnvironment.js measures every centre from the live league, clamps symmetrically, and is zero-centred by construction: mean tilt now exactly 0.0000 on all four seeds with club spread intact (best +1.1, worst -1.1). Post-fix 12-season drift -0.073 against a 0.15 ceiling, decomposing to progression -0.478 / survivorship-exit +0.424 / intake -0.019. The long shard was folded into DEFAULT_SHARDS, so npm test covers the project's three most behavioural regressions for the first time; local proof 1,167/1,167 across six shards. Public launch remains HOLD and launchReady stays false.
nextMilestone: Open S91 with a genuinely fresh live-code audit rather than an inherited lens — both items S89 left are now closed. Staged but deliberately unranked: separate elite-tail stretch (90+ density 0.76% -> 3.4% across 12 post-fix seasons) from free-agent-pool-growth selection (pool 1,720 -> 2,648 over the same window). Design a probe that separates them BEFORE ranking anything; the companion top-100 figure is confounded and must not be used as evidence on its own.
blockers: Pre-existing red outside the canonical receipt — test/realism-career-regression.test.js fails in the excluded long shard on 0.228 annual overall drift vs a 0.15 ceiling; verified to reproduce on pristine HEAD 8ddc310, queued as S90 calibration.

testingSurfaces.note: S90 folded `long` into DEFAULT_SHARDS.
